_comment: Buildings inside settlements (DESIGN §3.3). Every building needs 'hands' to run; staffing is linear (half staff = half effect). 'mandatory' buildings exist from founding and cannot be demolished; they are per tier ('tier'). Every other building is built by the player (Session 11, DECIDED by Omer 2026-11-05): 'minTier' is the lowest tier that may build it; 'cost' is paid in materials from the CLUSTER stockpile when the project is queued (DESIGN §4.2); construction then takes 'buildMonths' months with 'buildHands' spare hands (fewer hands → proportionally slower); 'requires' names a hex the settlement must work (river / shore / pasture). 'effects' are read by src/sim/economy.ts: farmingBonus and fishingBonus multiply those outputs (× staffing); granaryCapacityMonths adds months of capacity and granarySpoilageMult multiplies spoilage; goodsPerYear produces goods into the stockpile; sellsGoodsPerYear turns goods into money at goodsPrice; order and unlocks are recorded only — order has no effect until DESIGN §4.4 exists and unlocks (recruitment) waits for Phase 4. Names of the village hall and the metropolis hall are PLACEHOLDERS (DESIGN §5), so is 'Drill Yard'. All numbers are DRAFT, at MODEL SCALE ×3 (see data/economy.json modelScale): hall 30/150/300/600, granary 90/180/360/720.

buildings.name: Mill
buildings.blurb: Grinds the harvest of the whole settlement: +15 % farming output. Needs a river hex in the work zone.

buildings.name: Great Granary
buildings.blurb: Stone-built stores: +12 months of granary capacity, spoilage halved.

buildings.name: Fishing Wharf
buildings.blurb: Boats and drying racks: +50 % fishing output. Needs a shore, lake or river hex in the work zone. Later the port that reaches offshore fish.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.blurb: Employs 300 hands making goods (600 a year at full staff) into the cluster's stockpile. Work that pulls people in from the countryside.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.blurb: Sells up to 600 goods a year from the cluster's stockpile into the realm's treasury.

buildings.name: Chapel
buildings.blurb: Raises public order (+5) — recorded only, until public order exists (DESIGN §4.4).

buildings.name: Archery Range
buildings.blurb: Trains archers. Recruitment comes with Phase 4.

buildings.name: Stables
buildings.blurb: Horses for mounted units. Needs a pasture hex in the work zone (DESIGN §3.1). Recruitment comes with Phase 4.

buildings.name: Drill Yard
buildings.blurb: Trains melee levies (PLACEHOLDER name). Recruitment comes with Phase 4.

buildings.name: Palisade
buildings.blurb: Wooden wall. Effect comes with Phase 4.

buildings.name: Walls
buildings.blurb: Stone walls. Effect comes with Phase 4 (sieges).

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.blurb: Professional recruitment. Effect comes with Phase 4.

buildings.name: Ironworks
buildings.blurb: Armour and weapons. Effect comes with Phase 4.

buildings.name: Citadel
buildings.blurb: The strongest fortification. Effect comes with Phase 4.
